# anthropic_agent (Data Source)

Get information about an Agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_agent" "example" {
  id = "agent_01HqR2k7vXbZ9mNpL3wYcT8f"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
